the development of new visual cluster analysis methods to facilitate the analysis of complex clusters in data sets.
the development of new algorithms for enhanced visual analysis of cluster structures in a dissimilarity matrix, and for automatic determination of cluster numbers in such matrices.

the proposed algorithms are very promising in the field of data cluster analysis and they are expected to be very useful in practice.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Spectral VAT algorithm can effectively reveal hidden cluster structure for highly complex clusters, and that it can be used to assess cluster tendency and to partition data sets.
our algorithms are more effective than existing visual methods for cluster analysis, especially for complex cluster data sets.

spectral methods can enhance the VAT algorithm to better visualize complex clusters.
the spectral mapping of the dissimilarity matrix to a graph embedding space, followed by VAT reordering of the resulting matrix, is an effective strategy for visual analysis of complex clusters.
